answer.says: Good morning, Shri Hegde. I trust the bungalow is settling to your liking. I am about to step out for the morning paper; please, do not feel obliged to accompany me. The compound is quiet, and I suspect you wish to keep to your room.
answer.thought: The confusion of the file has become a living reality in the walls of this house. Hegde stands here, the man who was meant to have this key, and I must address him not as a ghost but as a fellow inhabitant of this clerical error. It is a strange dialectic: the state intended one thing, but the actuality is that we are both here. I must be civil, for the ethical life of the household depends on it, even if the metaphysical ground of my residence is a typo.
